newsitem.title: USA: Thomas & Betts sees more double-digit growth.
newsitem.headline: Thomas & Betts sees more double-digit growth.

text.p: Thomas & Betts Corp said Wednesday it expects double-digit growth in sales and earnings to continue as the end of the year approaches.
The company today reported third-quarter sales rose 18 percent to $351 million from $298 million a year ago. The company said net earnings rose 21 percent to $25.8 million from $21 million in 1995.
The company reported per share earnings of $0.64, compared to analysts' estimates of $0.63.

"Both sales and earnings are expected to continue double-digit growth as we approach the end of another year of record performance," said Chief Executive T. Kevin Dunnigan. "Our success with acquisitions continues, and we are excited about prospects for further growth and an expanded electronics business resulting from our recently announced agreement to acquire Augat Inc."
